name: arcgis-analyst
description: Read and query an ArcGIS Enterprise Portal from Claude Code. Bundles the ArcGIS MCP server plus skills for portal inventory, disciplined layer queries and inventory reports, and a read-only GIS analyst agent.

mcp_endpoint.title: ArcGIS MCP endpoint
mcp_endpoint.description: Full HTTPS URL of the ArcGIS platform MCP endpoint, including any ?token= query parameter. Example: https://portal.example.com/arcgis/platform/mcp?token=AAPT...

item_tag.title: Exposure tag
item_tag.description: The Portal item tag the MCP server is scoped to. Only items carrying this tag are visible to Claude. Defaults to mcp.
